title: Anchor reproduction on the verified rental (chunked Gram variant)
question: Does the rental, cleared bit-exact by M176c-dvc, reproduce the three sealed DomainNet anchors within their registered tolerances?

interpretation_registered_before_running.premise_fail: VOID — the dvc evidence is missing or not bit-exact
interpretation_registered_before_running.A1_fail: the 138k anchor missed 1e-6 — the SPM bin sums are not bit-exact on this torch version even though the pool check was; the rental then serves with the registered full-data tolerances only
interpretation_registered_before_running.A2_A3_fail: the rental cannot reproduce the sealed full-data anchors within 0.002 — it is VOID for the anchor stage; M176c candidates get a device-independent design
interpretation_registered_before_running.all_pass: the rental is fully cleared: the anchor stage and the candidate ladder may produce admissible numbers on it

anchors.a1_note: p=0.5 power-normalised SPM codes at 138k rows, penalty 1.0 (the sealed C4 cells_138k.p0.5)
anchors.a2_note: raw SPM full data, penalty 1.0 (the sealed C2 read Q_SPM(1923, 409832))
anchors.a3_note: p=0.5 power-normalised SPM full data, penalty 0.1 (the sealed C4 full_data_cells p0.5_lambda0.1)
